newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq finishes Wednesday with mixed performance.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq finishes Wednesday with mixed performance.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks finished mixed Wednesday after a late-session decline linked to a selloff in high-flying technology stocks trimmed earlier gains.
The Nasdaq composite index rose 2.3 points, or 0.2 percent, finishing unoffically at 1264.9, 7.5 points under the session high marked an hour before the close.
Declining issues outnumbered gainers 2147 to 2094, while the session yielded 195 new highs and 148 new lows.
Unofficial trading volume was about 578 million shares.

"Every market maker was kicking out positions at the end. These guys get scared when they see these big swing, so all the high flyers got wrapped around," said Brian Finnerty, Unterberg Harris managing director.
Finnerty cited Wednesday's wide swing in Intel Corp, the Nasdaq's most active issue, which ended at 120-7/8, up 1/8, after climbing to 124-1/2.
Similarly, Microsoft Corp ended with a 2-5/8 loss at 153-1/4, falling off a new all-time high 158, notched one hour before the market close.
On the upside Sun Microsystems, the third most-active issue after Intel and Microsoft, climbed 2-1/4 to 59-1/4 -- Brendan Intindola, Wall Street Desk, 212-859-1734.
